ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** upgrade from a build before migration 30 with walks kept, then open Navigate, pull the bar up and tap Share diagnostics. **Expect:** the app opens, the walks read back, and the share sheet offers a text headed "Chronicles <version> · ios <version>" (or android), with no device model (EH3a, EH5)

- [ ] **Do:** with the phone nearly full, change Distances in the walk settings. **Expect:** one line beside the capture buttons, "A setting wasn’t saved: the phone is full.", with Retry; it never covers the capture buttons, and Retry after freeing room clears it (EH7, EH13, EH14)
ops.intro: Every caught error is handled by its kind and kept in a log on the device (decision 0179, specs/errors-handled). Nothing here has run on a phone.

ops.body: - [ ] **Do:** play a voice memo in the viewer, then in a day replay and in the media editor. **Expect:** play, pause and seek work as before (`lib/playerControls`, moved out of each screen)
